name: ToolJet Cloud
tagline: The core loop is buildable, but a dependable replacement becomes a real weekend or multi-day project. For ToolJet Cloud, build and deploy a constrained internal data tool for a small team. The hard boundary is connectors, runtime, permissions, enterprise controls, and hosted operations, plus connectors, runtime reliability, and governance.
